text:
ashley: quick follow-up to the policy rollout conversation. spotted a risk: when weights shift across regions, local route caches may keep returning decisions that point at a drained region for too long. need an invalidation + degrade plan.

samir: saw the same in sim. two simple options: (a) TTL-shortening on policy change, or (b) targeted invalidation by route fingerprint. TTL approach is simpler but slower to converge. targeted invalidation is faster but more complex.

jun: if we run policy eval in a sidecar we can fanout invalidation events easily. if it's an in-process lib we'd need a cross-service RPC which is trickier. sidecar gives us async ack/queue semantics.

margo: proposal: compiler emits compact per-policy fingerprint batches (space-efficient bitset or Bloom) at compile-time. control-plane POSTs an invalidation referencing that blob. sidecars download and apply; depend on versioned stamps so duplicate deliveries are ok. add a safety TTL on all entries as a backstop.

ashley: two questions: (1) how big are these fingerprint blobs likely to be? (2) when should a sidecar evict immediately vs mark stale and probe?

samir: blobs should be modest — compile-time dedupe + sharding makes them small. we can cap batch size and shard by tenant. eviction policy: if route's recent qps > HOT_QPS (configurable) then mark-stale + immediate probe; otherwise evict lazily by assigning a short TTL. this avoids blast recomputes on cold keys.

jun: implement sidecar rate limits for invalidation processing. per-sidecar token-bucket and exponential backoff on fetching the fingerprint blob. also sidecars should expose /invalidate endpoint that accepts {policy_id, version, blob_url} and returns {accepted:true, queued:true|false}. idempotency by version stamp is required.

margo: observability: emit invalidation.event (policy_id, version, estimated_affected_routes, shard_count, sidecar_ack_count, sidecar_nack_count, avg_eviction_time). wire a canary alert: if >5% of targeted sidecars NACK or take >30s to evict, pause rollout.

ashley: rollout plan idea: canary 1% tenants with probing forced on for 10m, assess tail latency and MTR (mean time to route-stable), then 5% for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then global. abort criteria: 99p latency > baseline+50ms OR invalidation NACK rate >0.5% OR evict-time P95 > 20s.

samir: i'll add a sim job that replays traffic skewed toward a few hot routes and simulates region capacity dropouts. metrics to capture: time-to-first-successful-route, 99p latency, throttled-invalidation-count, and fallback-rate. can plug into policy preflight.

jun: i'll own sidecar changes: /invalidate API, versioned idempotency, rate limiting, fetch backoff, and safe fallback behavior if blob fetch fails (fall back to capacity-aware low-weight route).

margo: i'll own telemetry and dashboard. will add a small panel on the policy console showing invalidation health per rollout (acks, avg evict latency, failures). also add retention for 7d for quick postmortem lookups.

sre-oncall-bot: note: add SRE runbook steps: how to detect stuck invalidations (query sidecar_invalidations{policy_id=..} with last_ack < X) and how to roll back policy version via control-plane.

ashley: testing: local sim + staged cluster tests. sim steps: (1) compile policy + produce blob, (2) replay tenant traffic with hot route skew, (3) trigger invalidation and measure convergence, (4) inject sidecar fetch failures and region outage to exercise fallback.

samir: will wire sim and create job id route-inval-sim-3345678901. will attach knobs for HOT_QPS threshold and sidecar-rate-limit.

jun: small API sketch: 
```
POST /policy/v1/invalidate
{ "policy_id": "p-27", "version": "v42", "blob_url": "s3://policies/p-27/v42/bloom-000.bin" }
```
response: {"accepted":true, "queued":true, "version":"v42"} and sidecar metrics: invalidation_fetch_ms, invalidation_evicted_count.

margo: agree. add an internal-only /policy/v1/invalidate/status?policy_id=... endpoint for dashboard.

ashley: ownership: samir -> sim + preflight checks; jun -> sidecar impl + docs; margo -> telemetry + dashboard; i'll draft RFC appendix with API, rollout, and test matrix. target PRs this sprint.

sre-oncall-bot: deploy-note: policy-compiler branch compiled blob artifacts at s3://ci-artifacts/policies/3345678901/; sim queued: ci/job/route-inval-sim-3345678901.

ashley: thanks everyone. i'll put together the appendix and link the sim job. :thumbsup:
